issues.description: The commented example in the template Main.java instantiates Seal, Pig, and Goat with two constructor arguments (name and a second string), but the problem specification and the solution use constructors that only take the animal's name. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected constructors for the animal classes.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Main.java example consistent with the specification: either change the commented instantiations to use single-argument constructors (e.g. new Seal("Clarabelle")) or, if an extra attribute is intended, update the UML/problem statement and solution to include that attribute in Animal and the concrete classes. Preferably update the template Main.java to use single-argument constructors to match the UML and solution.
